name: nextjs
description: A Blaxel-native Next.js sandbox that shows live previews, filesystem writes, safe command checks, and agent handoff prompts.
longDescription: A polished Next.js development environment built for Blaxel sandboxes. It starts a live app on port 3000, exposes it through a secure preview URL, and includes a Sandbox Lab page that proves the runtime has real processes, filesystem access, networked preview, and agent-ready workflows. Built on Alpine Linux with Node.js 24, sandbox-api, git, curl, and npm pre-installed.
